comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 
Thanks for the PR.

We only want to remove the retired OpenAI models from the catalog. We don't want a runtime id mapping, for these reasons:
    - It silently changes the model, cost and behavior of saved configs. Picking a replacement is a product decision. For 
      example, gpt-image-1 → gpt-image-2.5-sunburst is above the product default (gpt-image-2).
    - The UI and logs show the saved id while the worker runs a different model.
    - Users should re-select a current model themselves, knowing its cost and behavior.

We're also planning a catalog update for all providers soon, which will cover this cleanup, so we're closing this PR to avoid overlapping changes. Thanks for the contribution.
